sar_narrative: The account of SYN_664320e7 exhibits a pattern of cash transactions that appear to be structured to evade the $10,000 reporting threshold. Between 2026-02-07 and 2026-04-28, the entity conducted 18 cash transactions totaling $73,333.31, which is 1.66x the declared monthly volume of $44,208. Notable transactions include $8,890.36 on 2026-03-03 and $8,274.06 on 2026-02-07. This activity is consistent with structuring under 31 U.S.C. § 5324. The matter is referred for further human investigation.

sop_excerpts.text:
1. Pull all cash transactions for the entity in the prior 90 days.
2. Identify sub-$10,000 cash deposits made within 14 days across multiple branches or distinct counterparties.
3. Confirm the declared business purpose against observed cash run-rate.
4. Aggregate per the BSA aggregation rule (single business day, same person).
5. Escalate to SAR review if the pattern persists across ≥3 sub-CTR deposits.
